title: Store and Query JSON
prompt: Store validated JSON alongside relational product columns; extract nested values and filter on a JSON property.
objective: Apply the SQLite concepts in store and query json and produce verifiable evidence.

starter.code:

expected_output: Valid JSON is queried, malformed inputs are handled, and version/build support is documented.
acceptance_criteria: Addresses every explicit requirement in the task: Store validated JSON alongside relational product columns; extract nested values and filter on a JSON property.
Valid JSON is queried, malformed inputs are handled, and version/build support is documented.

hints: Start with a tiny known dataset; write the intended schema and expected rows first.

grading_method: Server-side source-string checks are only a minimal rubric and do not execute arbitrary SQL. Verify SQL in a local SQLite CLI/API; performance, recovery and architecture tasks require human review.
retry_policy: Retries are allowed. Incorrect submissions award no XP; completion/reward idempotency remains backend-owned.
status_note: Unreviewed curriculum draft; human review and a local feature/version check are required before publication.
